We need to count carbonyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of the molecule. Possibly we need to retrieve IR spectra to see C=O stretch? Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). But we don't have SMILES. The prompt says "available input data:" but none given. Maybe the system expects us to request IR spectra which will indicate carbonyl presence. However counting carbonyl groups may be ambiguous without structure. Could be we need to use IR to detect C=O stretch peaks. But we need count. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons.

We need to decide minimal experiments. Perhaps IR is cheaper. Use ir_spectra tool. Then parse for C=O stretch peaks (~1700 cm-1). But counting number of carbonyl groups from IR may be tricky if overlapping. However typical IR shows one strong C=O stretch per carbonyl. So count peaks.

Let's request IR spectra.
